proposal.summary: CoreFTP Server (build 725 and below) allows an authenticated attacker to perform directory traversal via ../ in an HTTP PUT request, enabling file creation outside the intended directory.
proposal.cwe_quote: CoreFTP Server before 727 allows directory traversal (for file creation) by an authenticated attacker via ../ in an HTTP PUT request.

C.quote: CoreFTP Server before 727 allows directory traversal (for file creation) by an authenticated attacker via ../ in an HTTP PUT request.

A.quote: CoreFTP Server before 727 allows directory traversal (for file creation) by an authenticated attacker via ../ in an HTTP PUT request.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Validate the issue against a current deployment, reproduce the PUT request with ../ payload, determine filesystem write location and required privileges, and coordinate with the vendor for a patch or mitigation (deny ../ sequences and normalize paths).

evidence_quotes.quote: CoreFTP Server before 727 allows directory traversal (for file creation) by an authenticated attacker via ../ in an HTTP PUT request.

evidence_quotes.claim: Proof-of-concept demonstrating remote HTTP PUT with credentials
